senses.gloss: m. (נָכַשׁ) hoe, spud; digging with the spud.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 54a:8">B. Bath. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון שהכיש בה מ׳ אחד וכ׳</he> (Ms. R. <he>שנכש בה</he>) as soon as he has inserted the spud once, he has taken possession of the entire field.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 54a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מקום מַכּוּשׁוֹ בלבד</he> only the place where he dug.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 4:1:2">Y. Ned. IV, beg. 38ᶜ</cite> <he>קורדום של מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00666"><he>נִיכּוּשׁ</he></cite>.]
